hypotheses.justification: Split on whether G is locally compact. In the positive case, use the existing proof. Otherwise, G cannot be weakly locally compact: IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace supplies RegularSpace, hence R1Space, and WeaklyLocallyCompactSpace.locallyCompactSpace would give a contradiction. Thus the condition in HaarQuotient.weight is false, so weight and density are identically zero. Both integrals are zero, including when f takes ∞, since ENNReal.zero_div and zero multiplication apply.

Recover this instance from the remaining assumptions. Install LocallyCompactSpace H using hH.locallyCompactSpace; H inherits second countability, hence is sigma-compact. IsHaarMeasure extends IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts, so SigmaFinite.of_isFiniteMeasureOnCompacts gives SigmaFinite μH, and the SigmaFinite-to-SFinite instance supplies SFinite μH. The original proof then works unchanged. This also covers trivial groups.
